verdict.rationale: Cal.com's event-type API lets you create event types (docs-34), each with selectable durations (docs-4) and custom booking-form fields beyond name and email (docs-40, docs-59). Bookings get a location that defaults to Cal Video and can point to Zoom, Teams or Meet (docs-7). Pending bookings awaiting host confirmation and a BOOKING_REQUESTED trigger imply confirmation rules exist (docs-39, docs-42). Missing for 10: an explicit per-event-type 'requires confirmation' setting, documentation that locations are configured per event type rather than per booking or user, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
